title: ON ENTROPY CONTROL IN LLM-RL ALGORITHMS

bias_targets.methodology: Mathematical derivation of theoretical performance bounds to quantify the deviation (bias) introduced by entropy regularization in Large Language Model Reinforcement Learning (LLM-RL), followed by empirical evaluation of the proposed AEnt method's ability to reduce this bias on math-reasoning benchmarks like MATH, AIME24, and OlympiadBench.
